links.outcome: Gunning Fog Index readability of AI-generated and human-written informed consent documents
links.effect: Gunning Fog Index was 17.2 for ChatGPT-4, 23.1 for Bard, and 20 for human consents, all far above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: The Gunning Fog Index for ChatGPT-4 was 17.2 [IQR 16.5-18.2], better than Bard's 23.1 [IQR 20.5-24.7] and the human consents' 20 [IQR 19.2-20.9].

screen.reason: The study empirically compares LLM-generated informed consent documents to human-written documents using expert clinician ratings and readability formulas, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
